checks.evidence: Every Shot Spec element is in the prompt. Phone pose and box: 'from 52% to 74% across and from 66% to 86% down ... lies flat on its back on the table, screen up. Its long axis is turned about 20 degrees'. Phone content: 'thin raised red case lip ... very thin black bezel ... one continuous pure black glass rectangle'. Table far edge 'at about 63% down'. Bare corner '80% to 100% across and from 70% down'. Headline-safe wall 'left edge to 55% across, from the top edge down to 60%'. Window '62% to 98% across and from 4% to 60% down'. Tower 'about 74% to 85% across, its axis near 80%'. Light 'from out of frame above right'. Camera 'about 40 cm above the tabletop ... about 40 degrees below horizontal'. Safe area 'between 13% and 87% across; the phone at least 10% above the bottom edge'. Every must_not item appears in DO NOT INCLUDE or SETTING. The 11 still-card blocks are present and in order: STYLE (format), REFERENCE, FORMAT AND LAYOUT, SUBJECT with the prop content, HANDS, CONTACT, NEAR FOREGROUND, TEXT, SETTING, CAMERA, CONTINUITY, DO NOT INCLUDE.

There is one attachment, image 1 = STYLE-TOP@v1 (job e6bc8781, G-VIS-SHEET PASS). Ledger v2 medias: one image_references entry, e6bc8781. The prompt says: 'Image 1 is the approved look reference. Match its light, colour grade, film grain, the dark café wall, the night window and the lit Tirana clock tower. Image 1 has a headline, a small label and a page counter baked into it: do not copy any of its text, letters, numbers, highlight box or text layout. Its window has dark vertical bars; this picture's window has none.' I opened the file. That description matches it: label, headline, red highlight box, counter, subline, a dark pillar and bars at the window. The ban on copying its text covers the subline too.
The spec says 'hands: none visible'. The prompt says 'HANDS: no human hands, no fingers, no arms, no people anywhere in the picture.'

The resting contact is written as contact points: 'the back of the phone lies flat on the wood, touching it along all four edges, no edge raised, with a thin soft contact shadow hugging its outline ... nothing touches or overlaps it.'

The story prop PR-PHONE has its full content line: 'matte deep red #BE0F18 silicone case ... thin raised red case lip ... very thin black bezel ... pure black glass rectangle with evenly rounded corners, carrying only one soft, featureless warm sheen'. Its intended state is a blank screen, because the notification is HTML mapped on later (spec notes). So 'no text' and 'no screen content' do not empty a prop that needs text. There is no PR-PHONE prop sheet: the only phone image, STYLE@v1, failed G-VIS-SHEET. The spec writes the phone out in words instead, and the prompt carries those words in full.

The spec says 'text_in_image: none'. The prompt says 'TEXT: none. No text, letters or numbers anywhere in the picture: not on the wall, the window, the tower, the buildings, the table or the phone. All words are added later by the website'. No strings, so the 6-word limit does not come into play.

Every trap has a rule. Wall: 'no lamp, no sconce, no art, no picture frame, no shelf, no mirror, no poster, no plant, no chair'. Window opening: filled with the tower and the square, 'clear glass with no reflections; nothing in front of it'. Clock faces: 'softly glowing discs showing only the two clock hands, no readable numerals'. Square: 'no people, no cars, no signs'. Phone screen: off, by rule. Signage: 'no signage or shop names anywhere'.

No two instructions conflict. The box arithmetic holds: the phone ends at 74% across, the bare corner starts at 80%; the window bottom is at 60%, the table edge at 63%, and 'a thin strip of dark wall between'; the tower sits 74 to 85%, inside 13 to 87%. 'no human hands' is kept apart from 'the two clock hands'. 'shallow depth of field' fits 'the whole phone in sharp focus ... the window view soft bokeh'. Note, not a fail: 'about 40 degrees below horizontal' together with a window and an upright tower filling the top 60% would not be strict lens geometry. It is the spec's camera and matches the foreshortening of the phone box. The explicit layout fractions and 'the window frame and the tower stay perfectly vertical' tell the model how to resolve it.

previous_shot is null. The carry-over is in the prompt: STYLE-TOP look ('the same world, light and grade as image 1'), the thread phone ('the brand's recurring red-case phone, screen off', #BE0F18), and the 'warm tungsten light from out of frame above right' that WEB-CUP will match.

The asset type is still and the spec format is static, not a realistic-people format, so gpt_image_2_5 is allowed. The packet calls resolution 2k, quality medium and variant flare, which matches standards.json gpt_image_2_5. The aspect is 16:9, which equals the spec's camera.aspect (the gate checks this) and the prompt's 'one horizontal 16:9 image'. The reference is passed by job id as image_references, not a URL. No video, speaker or duration rules apply.

No word reads two ways in a way that harms the picture. 'no human hands' vs 'clock hands' is explicit. 'plate-glass window' is kept apart from 'no ... dinner plates'. 'square' is the plaza ('Below it the square: warm street lamps') and 'square stone tower' is its shape, and the context keeps them apart. 'frame' is qualified each time ('picture frame', 'thin dark frame', 'the window's bottom frame', 'bottom edge of the frame').

Every matching pattern carries its prevention. FL-02 has structure lines: 'a single rectangular opening in a thin dark frame with four straight inner edges; no mullions, bars or cross frames', the table's 'straight, level line', and the phone's lip, bezel and glass. FL-03 and FL-11 have contact and physics lines: 'touching it along all four edges ... contact shadow', 'no ... extra phones'. FL-04 has the content line and no blanket negative against a needed prop. FL-05 and FL-10 have the wall and window rules: 'no signage or shop names anywhere'. FL-13: the prompt never asks for a logo, 'none drawn in any corner', and the real logo is in the HTML nav. FL-01, 06, 07, 08, 09 and 12 do not apply: still, no hands, no text, no people, single model.
